slides.title: New painting contractor tracking renewal dates:

slides.label: Day 1
slides.title: Color-coded spreadsheet.
slides.body: Every license, every policy, every expiration date. Honestly beautiful.

slides.label: Month 6
slides.title: Two tabs: "FINAL" and "final (2)".
slides.body: Neither one has the new insurance certificate.

slides.label: Month 9
slides.title: The GC asks for your COI.
slides.body: You send last year's. They notice.

slides.label: 1 year
slides.title: Turns out the lead-safe certificate expires too.
slides.body: Found out from a client's checklist.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Day 1 energy lasts longer when the dates come to you.
slides.body: Contractor license, business license, liability, workers' comp, vehicle registration, lead-safe cert. Write them down once.
